transport: iroh QUIC with mandatory X25519MLKEM768 TLS and an ML-DSA-65 server signature bound to each connection. Relays and address lookup by n0, so no node needs an open port.

notes: Zoka Quantic Testnet v2: the fully post-quantum private pool (Plonky3 STARK over Poseidon2, X-Wing note encryption, ML-DSA node identities). Test coins with no value. It replaces the v1 testnet.
Launched on 2026-10-29: block 1 (69249437d8c35b7e4bf28ec524491fe18384b9869670fadff546fef29148fdb2) carries the 5,000,000 ZKA premine and is fixed in the binary.
A seed is pinned by its iroh endpoint id and the key id (blake3) of its ML-DSA-65 public key; `quantic-pq-node identity` prints both.
Peers learned from other nodes are dialed and authenticated before they are shared. Blocks are validated locally whoever serves them.
